classification.difficultyReason: Recognise a semicircular annulus and subtract the inner semicircle area from the outer semicircle area.

content.prompt: Find the approximate value of the shaded area shown opposite. Use $\pi\approx\dfrac{22}{7}$.

spec.description: Concentric upper semicircles of radii 3 cm and 5 cm, with only the intervening band shaded light purple. A red centre point and dashed red radius extend rightwards. The inner radius is labelled above the baseline and the outer radius is dimensioned below it. Ordinary source blue boundaries are rendered black; the meaningful purple region uses the house light-purple fill.
spec.mathematics: The two semicircles share a centre and horizontal diameter line. Inner radius 3 cm; outer radius 5 cm. The shaded region is half an annulus.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied measurements and the requested shaded region are visible.

answer.worked:
Subtract the smaller semicircle from the larger semicircle.

$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac12\pi(5^2-3^2)\\A&=\frac12\pi(25-9)\\A&=8\pi\text{ cm}^2\\A&\approx8\times\frac{22}{7}\text{ cm}^2\\A&\approx25\frac17\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
